gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
The negotiators refused to give ___ to the hijackers' demands.
gaps.explanation: give in (to) = stop arguing and accept; give up = quit.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
I'll pay you ___ as soon as I get paid.
gaps.explanation: pay somebody back = return borrowed money; pay off a debt = finish paying it.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).
